title: arenaria holostea subsp. macrantha
intro: Arenaria holostea subsp. macrantha, commonly known as Mountain Sandwort, is a plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The Mountain Sandwort has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Sandwort include its antiseptic, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, making it a valuable remedy for wound healing and infections. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Sandwort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
